title: Design System: SmileCraft Digital Dental Studio

shadows.name: cyber-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA buttons and active tab glow.

motion.name: ease-precision
motion.purpose: Default easing for UI transitions and hover lifts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-impact conversion button with clipped polygon corner.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0EA5E9; color: #0B0F19; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 12px 26px; border: none; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 75%, 90% 100%, 0 100%); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #38BDF8; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 25px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.6); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Subtle glass button with precision cyan hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.3); padding: 12px 26px; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; display: inline-block; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.15); border-color: #0EA5E9; }

components.name: Treatment Chip
components.description: Interactive procedure card with top-border reveal on hover.
components.html:
🦷
DENTAL IMPLANTS
3D CBCT GUIDED
components.css: .ds-treatment-chip { background: #111827; border: 1px solid rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.15); padding: 24px 20px; position: relative; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.25s ease; font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; } .ds-treatment-chip::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: #0EA5E9; transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-treatment-chip:hover { border-color: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.45); background: #1E293B; transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-treatment-chip:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-treatment-icon { color: #06B6D4; margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: 1.5rem; } .ds-treatment-title { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-treatment-sub { font-size: 0.72rem; color: #06B6D4; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }

narrative.overview: SmileCraft Digital Dental Studio expresses extreme clinical accuracy, sub-micron diagnostic confidence, and patient tranquility through a modern high-tech visual language. Rooted in deep cyber-dark foundations (#0B0F19), the interface radiates precision using electric cyan (#0EA5E9) and luminous cyan accents (#06B6D4), high-contrast tabular telemetry, and condensed technical typography.
keyCharacteristics: Deep obsidian foundation paired with luminous cyan laser-accent glow lines.
High-contrast Barlow Condensed technical headlines paired with clean geometric Barlow body text.
Live telemetry data readouts communicating measurable diagnostic accuracy.
Clipped geometric polygons and sharp architectural borders reflecting robotic CAD/CAM milling precision.

rules.name: The Precision Cyan Accent Rule
rules.body: Cyan (#0EA5E9) is reserved for active diagnostic data, high-priority conversion triggers, and live system feedback. It illuminates the interface rather than washing over entire large backgrounds.

rules.name: The Cyber Glow Rule
rules.body: Depth is established through luminous neon glows (0 0 20px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.35)) and value shifts from deep slate to elevated slate, never muddy gray drop shadows.

dos: Do showcase tangible diagnostic accuracy metrics (< 20 µm, 60 Min, 90% Less Radiation).
Do emphasize patient comfort benefits alongside cutting-edge hardware.
Do use crisp vector React Icons from @/icons with dedicated semantic sizing.
Do maintain high WCAG AA contrast against dark backgrounds.
donts: Don't use cartoon tooth graphics or generic smiling family stock clip art.
Don't use warm sepia or pastel beige tones that dilute the high-precision digital architecture.
Don't clutter screens with unformatted phone numbers or non-functional buttons.
Don't use unstyled default browser alert dialogs or generic form controls.
